exact_question: Under the pinned hillipop-ede_n3 source/configuration, the same fixed admitted common background and matched validated z=810 start state used by Q051, does the actual native CLASS/P6 low-z implementation produce q=xHeII=10^-6 versus q=0 electron-fraction and Thomson-optical-depth histories that are reproducible, trajectory-consistent with the literal source-real dynamics, and contained within Q051's uniform analytic bounds; and what are the realized sup|Delta x_e| and sup|Delta tau_T| with a validated numerical error certificate?

ordered_work: Recover the literal Pion/SWIFT dispatch equations, threshold and equality convention. Check their dependence on h, q, v and the common background against pinned source.

On E=0 intersect the archived cell with both arms' selector conditions, h_L=h-q, v_L>=v_R, proved phase5 thermal cap and shared constants. Treat all common and one-sided limiting branch fields. Do not give the two arms independently chosen H or fit parameters.

First determine whether L-SWIFT/R-HMLA is feasible on this face. If empty, prove exclusion. If nonempty, directly enclose the weighted paired source derivative dprime, or prove the sufficient C_SWIFT(h-q)/C_HMLA(h)<1/(1-q/h) uniformly on that feasible set. Keep useful rate/temperature compensation if a channelwise C bound is too coarse.

Use one bounded analytical/interval prototype. Return the first closed-cell certificate, a source-admissible face witness showing the proposed invariant fails, or the first precise unresolved inequality. A face witness is distinct from a witness on the matched trajectory.
success: Rigorous inward lower-face certificate on all source-admissible branches of this entire cell, or rigorous exclusion of mixed dispatch with the remaining fields certified.
failure: Certified admissible outward face witness falsifies this proposed barrier under the specified state constraints. It does not alone establish a trajectory sign reversal.
inconclusive: Exact remaining nonempty feasible box, branch and inequality with input hashes; no blind full-history refinement.
stop_condition: Stop after this one cell is classified, or after the first specific closure obstruction within the first bounded prototype. Return result to routing before continuing to later mixed cells.
